entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

The petitioner has prayed for regular bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 308, 418, 419, 420 of the IPC and Section 40, 41 of the Clinical Establishment Registration and Regulation Act.

entities.text: Clinical Establishment Registration and Regulation Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
As per FIR, the allegation against the petitioner is that he conducted the operation of the informant's wife for removal of her cancer organ but when the informant took to another doctor for treatment it was found that the informant's wife has no cancer problem after that informant Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.24734 of 2023(2) dt.22-05-2023 lodged this case against the petitioner.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
He has falsely been implicated in this case.

The petitioner has no any clinic nor he is a practicing doctor rather the petitioner has given twenty thousand rupees to the informant for Nandu Yadav @ Nand Kumar Yadav vs The State Of Bihar on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30139358/
1 treatment of her wife and when the petitioner demanded his due informant and other assaulted him.

entities.text: Nandu Yadav @ Nand Kumar Yadav vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He has got no criminal antecedent.
As per Annexure-2, good sense has been prevailed between the parties.
It is further submitted that the petitioner is languishing in judicial custody since 30.01.2023.
Learned APP appearing for the state has opposed the prayer of regular bail.
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the facts and circumstances of the case as well as custody of the petitioner, this court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

The above named petitioner is directed to be released on bail in connection with Tilauthu P.S. Case No. 251 of 2022 on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.24734 of 2023(2) dt.22-05-2023 amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, Ist Class, Dehri-on-Sone, Rohtas.
(Sunil Kumar Panwar, J) Manishkumar/-
